title: 군검찰단의 조직에 관한 규정 / queue:ADDENDUM:32530:20220311:00001:part:1/1

ADDENDUM <Presidential Decree No. 32530, March 11, 2022>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on July 1, 2022.

Article 2 (Relationship to Other Statutes or Regulations)
Where, as at the time this Decree enters into force, another statute or regulation refers to the former Regulations on the Organization of Military Prosecution Departments or a provision thereof, and this Decree contains a corresponding provision, the reference shall be deemed to refer to this Decree or the corresponding provision hereof in lieu of the former Regulations or provision.
